description: This PHP source file defines the class 'quicksearchQuery', which handles AJAX requests for a quick search feature in the SuiteCRM application. The class provides methods to perform search queries across different modules, handle external API searches, and format the results in JSON format. It also manages constructing SQL where clauses, filtering duplicates, and interfacing with module beans to retrieve data.

classes.name: quicksearchQuery
classes.description: A class responsible for handling AJAX quick search queries within SuiteCRM, supporting module searches, user list retrieval, external API integrations, and result formatting.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a module search based on provided arguments and returns formatted JSON results.

methods.name: get_contact_array
methods.description: Executes a contact list query and returns filtered JSON results.

methods.name: get_user_array
methods.description: Returns an array of user data matching a search condition, optimized for Active users.

methods.name: externalApi
methods.description: Fetches search results from an external API based on provided arguments.

methods.name: constructWhere
methods.description: Builds an SQL WHERE clause based on search conditions and module context.

methods.name: formatResults
methods.description: Formats raw database results into a structured array with total count and module info.

methods.name: filterResults
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from search results.

methods.name: getRawResults
methods.description: Retrieves raw search results across modules, constructing appropriate queries.

methods.name: prepareResults
methods.description: Prepares and formats raw results into final displayable data.

methods.name: getUserResults
methods.description: Returns search results specifically for user modules.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Merges module list results with existing data based on sorting and limits.

methods.name: updateContactName
methods.description: Formats contact names according to locale preferences.

methods.name: overrideContactId
methods.description: Replaces contact ID fields with the primary 'id' in results.

methods.name: prepareArguments
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments for search queries.

methods.name: prepareField
methods.description: Prepares individual field data; meant for overriding in subclasses.

methods.name: getUserArray
methods.description: Retrieves user array based on search condition, respecting full name display settings.

methods.name: getNonPrivateTeamsWhere
methods.description: Constructs additional SQL conditions to exclude private teams unless specified.

methods.name: getJsonEncodedData
methods.description: Encodes data array into JSON format.

methods.name: getFormattedJsonResults
methods.description: Formats results and encodes into JSON for output.

methods.name: getFilteredJsonResults
methods.description: Filters duplicate results and encodes into JSON.

methods.name: updateQueryArguments
methods.description: Sets default arguments for query execution.

methods.name: updateContactArrayArguments
methods.description: Prepares arguments specifically for contact search; can be overridden.

methods.name: updateTeamArrayArguments
methods.description: Adds team-related conditions to the arguments.
